items.text: Rams optimistic WR Puka Nacua (calf) will play vs Raiders. Felt better Saturday; 'as long as no setbacks, feel good about him being available.' MRI better than hoped; did not practice Friday.
items.why: Feeling better Saturday after calf issue; source confidence barring setbacks.
items.implication: High-upside WR1 if active in favorable spot; monitor warmups closely as late window.
items.opportunity: Full target share with Davante Adams OUT; reverse any fade.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall (quad) unlikely to play today vs Dolphins after missing three games. May work out but hasn't been full participant; 'a bit early.'
items.why: Quad strain; limited recent participation, not full yet.
items.implication: Expect committee or Braelon Allen lead; fade Hall until confirmed.
items.opportunity: Braelon Allen RB1 upside in good matchup if Hall out.

items.text: Ravens rule out QB Lamar Jackson (high ankle sprain) vs. Bengals; Tyler Huntley to start again. Jackson was close but will miss third straight; expected back next week per later notes.
items.why: High ankle sprain; downgraded Saturday after limited practice.
items.implication: Huntley starts; Ravens pass game and rushing attack shift; fade Jackson-dependent stacks.
items.opportunity: Boost to Zay Flowers, Rashod Bateman, Mark Andrews, Isaiah Likely usage.

items.text: Giants RB Cam Skattebo expected to resume role as team's lead back vs Texans. JJ McCarthy long leash.
items.implication: Solid RB2/flex with volume; Berry had as hate but role confirmed.

items.text: Packers activated RB Josh Jacobs; expected to play Sunday at Detroit after layoff.
items.why: Activated from IR/absence; set for return.
items.implication: Workload question after layoff; monitor snaps vs committee.
items.opportunity: Potential bellcow if full go, but rust risk.

items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith for Monday Night vs Dallas; also Dontayvion Wicks OUT. Saquon Barkley Q but expected.
items.why: Injury report; top two WRs sidelined.
items.implication: Eagles WR depth thinned for MNF; targets to Goedert/others.
items.opportunity: Dallas Goedert and remaining WRs elevated; Saquon if active.

items.text: Berry: By end of year Jonah Coleman will be the Broncos RB you wish you had. Should be rostered in 100% of leagues. Activated from IR, expected.
items.why: Prior hype + activation; inefficient Dobbins/Harvey open door.

items.text: Status of Lamar Jackson (ankle), Puka Nacua (calf), and Breece Hall (quad) very crucial to Sunday's DFS main slate. Hoping early news. Sneaky important scratches: Brian Robinson, Tyler Warren, Emeka Egbuka.
items.why: Star Qs drive slate; overlooked OUTs change backfields/WRs.
items.implication: Pivot DFS builds on resolutions; elevate beneficiaries of sneaky outs.
items.opportunity: Full Bijan if BRob out; other RB/WR bumps from Warren/Egbuka.

items.text: ETR Sunday injuries dump: QUESTIONABLE include Lamar Jackson, Puka Nacua, Breece Hall, Baker Mayfield, Rico Dowdle, Jordan Mason, Christian Kirk, Tank Dell, Jonah Coleman.
items.why: Saturday night full status report for fantasy.
items.implication: Monitor early news on stars for DFS/lineups; many game-time.

items.text: ETR OUTs: Mike Evans, Deebo Samuel, Davante Adams, Rashee Rice, Jeremiyah Love, David Montgomery, Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren, Zach Charbonnet, Brian Robinson.
items.why: Confirmed scratches impacting depth charts and roles.
items.implication: Clear upgrades to teammates; handcuffs and backups elevated.
items.opportunity: Bijan full workload (BRob out); Kyren/others if Charbonnet; no Rice/Adams targets.

items.text: ETR INs/activations expected: Josh Jacobs, Quinshon Judkins, Jordan Addison, TJ Hockenson, AD Mitchell, Caleb Douglas, Rashod Bateman, Sean Tucker.
items.implication: Role returns; monitor snap shares post-absence.
items.opportunity: Judkins/Jacobs immediate RB value; Addison WR boost.

items.text: David Montgomery OUT (with Jahwar Jordan); elevates other DET RBs. Emeka Egbuka OUT.
items.implication: Jahmyr Gibbs full work; TB WR adjustments.
items.opportunity: Gibbs RB1 lock; other TB targets up.

items.text: Texans activated WR Tank Dell (first action in ~2 years); 49ers WR Christian Kirk activated/expected; Vikings Jordan Mason activated.
items.implication: Dell/Kirk immediate WR depth/target competition; Mason RB committee.
items.opportunity: Monitor roles for Dell (HOU), Kirk (SF amid WR outs).

items.text: Berry posts top 10 overall fantasy rankings for Week 7 heading into Sunday (image); includes high Puka confidence pre-final news.
items.implication: Strong starts for listed; Puka elevated despite Q.

items.text: Rarely buy RB-as-WR statements, but given 49ers dire WR situation (Evans/Deebo out) and Kaelon Black, tempted to buy CMC lining up more in slot.
items.why: CMC smile on slot question amid WR injuries; usual skepticism overridden by context.
items.implication: Potential receiving boost for CMC in depleted WR corps.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets for CMC; fade remaining 49ers WRs.

items.text: Berry loves A.J. Brown @ CHI (usage back in real role, Bears good for yardage) and Tucker Kraft @ DET (Lions TE buffet, 9 TE TDs allowed).
items.why: Matchup and usage: Bears secondary soft, Lions leak to TEs/WRs.
items.implication: Strong start signals; Brown WR10 range, Kraft TE upside.

items.text: Berry loves Jaylen Warren @ NO, Chuba Hubbard vs TB, Bucky Irving @ CAR for big workloads in friendly matchups. Saquon in line to play MNF (efficient when healthy, Dallas soft vs RBs).
items.why: Volume + matchup juice; defenses carved by RBs.

items.text: Berry hates Josh Jacobs @ DET (workload question after long layoff), Rome Odunze vs NE (Gonzalez shadow, outside targets), Josh Downs @ MIN (target share/low-scoring), Travis Kelce @ SEA (tough matchup).
items.why: Layoff rust for Jacobs; nasty coverage/matchups and role issues for others.
items.implication: Sit/fade in tough spots despite name value.
items.conflict: Jacobs activated/expected; usage may override if full snaps
